issue.title: v2 ack display surfaces: Ledger Tools unacked pill, MEET link-time dot, and a Mac Capture Ack action

task_type_fields.proposal: Once bob gcal ack ships: render an amber unacked pill in bob-plugins Ledger Tools and a MEET link-time dot from the additive ack object ({state, scope, via, at, ack_stale}) that bob gcal list/sync -f json rows carry, and add an Ack action to Bob Mac Capture's Command-E picker driven entirely by bob gcal ack -i <id> -f json (thin client: the app renders what bob returns and never re-derives queue membership). Consolidated design: research:202611/gcal_external_event_ack/gcal_external_event_ack.md (Other surfaces + Implementation plan phase 6).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The ack epic is bob-cli-only by design: the research recommends shipping display surfaces as separate cross-repo work after the CLI is real, since bob-plugins and bob-mac-capture consume the released JSON contract additively (decodeIfPresent on an installed bob) and the Mac work is gated by macOS CI. Bundling them would couple three repos' releases to one epic.

issue.creation_reason: The gcal external-event ack epic (plan sase_plan_gcal_external_event_ack.md) deliberately defers all cross-repo display work until the bob gcal ack CLI and its JSON contract ship; this bead keeps that v2 scope from being lost.
